# Darafort — Nigeria's Premier Cold-Chain Logistics & Haulage Platform
> Darafort (https://daraexpress.com) is Nigeria's leading technology-enabled cold-chain logistics company, climate-tech startup, and commercial haulage aggregator. We operate an aggregated network of 300+ pharma-grade refrigerated reefer trucks and 500 dry freight trucks connecting Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, and all 36 Nigerian states.

Darafort solves perishable supply-chain friction, post-harvest losses, and pharmaceutical spoilage across West Africa by combining dedicated refrigerated assets with proprietary IoT temperature monitoring telemetry and the DaraOS digital platform.

- **Hub Locations**: Lagos (Primary Hub), Abuja (FCT Central Hub), Port Harcourt (South-South Hub), Kano (Northern Corridor).
- **Network Reach**: All 36 Nigerian states + Federal Capital Territory (FCT).
- **Fleet Capacity**: 300+ dedicated refrigerated reefer trucks and 500+ commercial haulage trucks.
- **Available Truck Sizes**: 5-Ton, 10-Ton, 15-Ton, 20-Ton, and 30-Ton heavy-duty articulated reefer trailers.
- **Temperature Capabilities**: Multi-zone temperature control ranging from -25°C (deep frozen) to +25°C (controlled ambient), maintaining ±0.1°C precision via calibrated IoT sensors.
- **Compliance Standards**: Good Distribution Practice (GDP) compliant for healthcare and pharmaceuticals, NAFDAC regulatory standards.
- **Insurance Coverage**: Comprehensive Goods-in-Transit (GIT) insurance on all booked freight runs.

## Major Transport Corridors & Interstate Routes in Nigeria
Darafort operates scheduled and dedicated interstate haulage on Nigeria's highest-volume industrial corridors:
- **Lagos to Abuja (FCT)**: ~750 km express route (24–36 hour delivery timeline) for pharmaceutical supplies, frozen foods, and dry freight.
- **Lagos to Port Harcourt (Rivers State)**: ~620 km corridor connecting commercial manufacturing hubs to oil & gas and retail centers.
- **Lagos to Kano & Kaduna**: Northern agro-allied and FMCG corridor linking southern seaports with northern markets.
- **Lagos to Onitsha & Aba**: Commercial trade corridor serving major wholesale and pharmaceutical distribution markets.
- **Lagos to Ibadan**: High-frequency intra-southwest express haulage and distribution.
- **Port-to-Warehouse Haulage**: Container evacuation and bonded terminal haulage from Apapa Port and Tin Can Island to inland container depots and manufacturing facilities.

---

## How Logistics Pricing & Haulage Rates Work in Nigeria
Commercial haulage rates in Nigeria are determined by four primary operational variables:
1. **Distance & Highway Corridors**: Mileage between origin pickup (e.g., Lagos ports or factories) and destination states.
2. **Vehicle Capacity & Tonnage**: 5-ton light trucks, 10-ton medium-duty haulage, 15-ton, or 30-ton heavy-duty multi-axle trailers.
3. **Temperature Requirement**:
   - Deep Frozen (-18°C to -25°C) for seafood, poultry, ice cream, and meat.
   - Chilled Cold Chain (+2°C to +8°C) for vaccines, insulin, biologics, and fresh dairy.
   - Controlled Ambient (+15°C to +25°C) for pharmaceuticals and temperature-sensitive dry goods.
4. **Fuel Index & Road Security**: Dynamic fuel indexing, armed escort options for high-value cargo, and toll optimizations.

To get an instant rate estimate:
- [Instant Rate Calculator](https://daraexpress.com/booking-calculator): Calculate instant price estimates for any state combination and truck size.
